name: crul
text:
@roytang Thanks to this post TIL about the 100 videos per playlist bug. I should have suspected something when several playlist I had dowloaded had exactly 100 videos...

I'll be using your script in the future!

Here it is as a one-liner:
console.log([...document.querySelectorAll("a.ytLockupMetadataViewModelTitle")].map(item => item.href.split("&list")[0]).join("\n"));

I think your version is better (more legible), but the one-liner is convenient for the bookmarklet:

javascript:(() => console.log([...document.querySelectorAll("a.ytLockupMetadataViewModelTitle")].map(item => item.href.split("&list")[0]).join("\n")))();
